before.story: Trump Waives New Russia Sanctions
before.summary: President Trump signed an executive waiver temporarily suspending newly enacted congressional sanctions and tariffs on Russia, drawing sharp criticism from Volodymyr Zelenskyy and bipartisan concern in Congress.

after.story: Trump Defends Russia Sanctions Waivers
after.summary: Following the temporary suspension of congressional sanctions on Russia, President Trump defended the move as a peace measure while clashing with Ukrainian leadership over ongoing war aims, as Kyiv also welcomed a resumption of US intelligence sharing earlier in the week.

note: President Trump publicly defended the sanctions waiver as a peace measure while trading barbs with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy.

before.story: Violent Protests and Riots Across France
before.summary: Widespread demonstrations against rising living costs devolved into severe riots, looting, and clashes with police across multiple French cities earlier in the week, prompting thousands of arrests.

after.story: Violent Cost-of-Living Protests Spread to Italy
after.summary: Following days of severe riots, looting, and thousands of arrests across France over rising living costs, civil unrest spilled over into neighboring countries, with protesters clashing with police and looting stores in central Milan.

note: The widespread cost-of-living protests and violent riots expanded internationally from France into major Italian cities like Milan.
